caption: The drawing depicts two large, brown metal objects that resemble pieces of tack, possibly parts of a horse bit or bridle hardware, set against a plain, off-white background. Both objects feature multiple rivets and rounded edges, with the left object having a lighter patina and visible engraved or etched patterns, including swirling lines and what appears to be a stylized figure. The right object has a more uniformly rust-toned surface and no visible decorative elements. A thick, tan-colored rope is looped through large holes at the tops of both pieces, securing them together. There are also two metallic, curved elements in light gray, crossing between the objects, and at the bottom, a straight, thin metal bar connects them, ending in round loops on each side. Two circular, silver-colored balls or beads are attached to the lower ends of the pieces. The objects are arranged to overlap in the center, and the overall composition is balanced and centrally placed on the canvas.
title: Cowboy's Hackamore Bit
